articles.title: TSMC's A14 is ready for design-in with PDK 0.9
articles.summary: A14 uses second-generation nanosheet transistors with flexible cell types, so designers put fast Boost Cells on critical paths and power-saving Low-Power Cells everywhere else. TSMC claims 50% better energy efficiency and 23% higher logic density than N2P, and a later move to A13 shrinks die area about 6% without changing the design flow.

articles.title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy up to 1 million solar-powered orbital data center satellites, with 100,000 due by November 2035
articles.summary: SpaceX has been authorized to launch a constellation of up to 1 million AI satellites that would link to each other optically and reach Earth through Starlink, with the 1 million count acting as a regulatory ceiling rather than a promised fleet. SpaceX plans to equip them with Nvidia Rubin GPUs and Vera CPUs, relying on Starship's falling launch costs to compete with terrestrial datacenter prices

articles.title: NERC's first standards require data centers of 50 MW or more to share power models and trip settings, after 3.8 GW of Virginia load dropped off the grid at once
articles.summary: On July 22, Northern Virginia facilities drawing 3,800 MW switched to backup after a routine line fault, spiking frequency and voltage, and at least eight such events have shed 200 to 1,800 MW since 2022. AI training makes it worse, since synchronized GPUs pulse between full power and near idle, and a 100 MW facility swung 10 to 15 MW every 2.5 seconds. Simulations show those pulses can resonate with grid natural frequencies, so NERC also plans ride-through and oscillation criteria next year.

articles.title: Quick Take: AMD's Helios as a Plug-and-Play AI Appliance Standard
articles.summary: AMD's Helios combines AMD CPU, GPU, and Ethernet with the ROCm framework in a plug-and-play AI solution using OCP's ORW form factor. Positioned as a competitive alternative to NVIDIA's offerings, AMD focuses on integration and easier software porting from CUDA to ROCm. Though larger cloud providers depend on NVIDIA or custom AI ASICs, smaller providers may leverage Helios's integration for straightforward deployment and operation.

articles.title: SK hynix to Start 3D DRAM Production in 2031
articles.summary: SK hynix plans to start mass production of 3D DRAM by 2031, potentially utilizing 100-layer designs based on its current roadmap. The production requires advanced techniques like multi-deck stacking and hybrid bonding, drawing from technology licensed from YMTC. This shift involves completely overhauling SK hynix's DRAM architecture and manufacturing process.

articles.title: Xpeng says its IRON humanoid will sell at roughly the median price of its EVs
articles.summary: Xpeng's EVs run from 119,800 to 309,800 yuan (about $18,000 to $44,000), and an executive gave that as the benchmark for the future cost of their humanoid, IRON. IRON carries over 1,500 tactile sensing points, with 76 degrees of freedom and three in-house Turing AI chips. Mass production starts in January. Store trials follow in Q1 2027, and public sales are targeted for Q2. Xpeng wants to sell tens of thousands next year, funded by a $900 million robotics round at a $6.3 billion valuation, while its stock is down 55% this year.

articles.title: 2 California companies are buying Nvidia's most advanced chips. Those companies are actually Chinese-owned, a CBS News investigation reveals
articles.summary: Nvidia's advanced chips are being sold to US-based companies that are actually Chinese-owned, raising concerns about evading export controls. California companies RiCloud AI and Aivres, linked to Chinese firms, have been involved in questionable dealings, including sales to Southeast Asian firms tied to Chinese tech companies. Nvidia's accounting changes may obscure customer locations, prompting potential Senate investigations into export violations and espionage.

articles.title: EU delays its vote on bloc-wide approval of Tesla's "hands-off, eyes-on" driver assistance
articles.summary: The Technical Committee for Motor Vehicles had been expected to vote after skipping two earlier meetings, following the Netherlands' approval in April. Tesla Assisted Driving, renamed from FSD after regulator concerns, can steer, accelerate, and brake, but needs constant driver supervision. About 12 countries have approved it, with Italy the largest, but EU-wide approval takes 15 of 27 states representing 65% of the population, and a rejection would invalidate the national approvals already granted.

articles.title: AMD claims GPU frequency world record with Radeon RX 9060 XT at 4.837 GHz
articles.summary: AMD's Radeon RX 9060 XT reached a new GPU frequency world record of 4.837 GHz with liquid nitrogen cooling.

articles.title: Ariane 6 delivers 36 Amazon Leo satellites on its 10th straight success
articles.summary: Ariane 64 placed all 36 Amazon Leo satellites in orbit on November 24, nine days after a Vulcan failure to deliver its payload destroyed 40 others.
